flush_timeout.description: Sets the time after which a batch will be sent regardless of its size.

max_size.description: Defines the configuration for the maximum size of a batch.

min_size.description: Defines the configuration for the minimum size of a batch.

cache_size.description:
Is the maximum number of active partition batchers kept in the LRU
cache when partitioning is enabled. When the limit is reached, the least
recently used partition is flushed and removed. Default is 10000. Must be positive.

idle_timeout.description:
Is the duration a partition may stay empty before it is removed.
Keep it above the data arrival interval to avoid churning partitions. Default is 90s.
Must be positive.

metadata_keys.description:
Is a list of client.Metadata keys that will be used to partition
the data into batches. If this setting is empty, a single batcher instance
will be used. When this setting is not empty, one batcher will be used per
distinct combination of values for the listed metadata keys.

Empty value and unset metadata are treated as distinct cases.

Entries are case-insensitive. Duplicated entries will trigger a validation error.

partition.description: Defines the partitioning of the batches configuration.

sizer.description:
Determines the type of size measurement used by the batch.
If not configured, use the same configuration as the queue.
It accepts "requests", "items", or "bytes".

batch_config.description: Defines a configuration for batching requests based on a timeout and a minimum number of items.

batch.description: It configures how the requests are consumed from the queue and batch together during consumption.

block_on_overflow.description:
Determines the behavior when the component's TotalSize limit is reached.
If true, the component will wait for space; otherwise, operations will immediately return a retryable error.

num_consumers.description:
Is the maximum number of concurrent consumers from the queue.
This applies across all different optional configurations from above 
(e.g. wait_for_result, block_on_overflow, storage, etc.).

queue_size.description: Represents the maximum data size allowed for concurrent storage and processing.

sizer.description:
Determines the type of size measurement used by this component.
It accepts "requests", "items", or "bytes".

storage.description:
If not empty, enables the persistent storage and uses the component specified
as a storage extension for the persistent queue.

wait_for_result.description:
Determines if incoming requests are blocked until the request is processed or not.
Currently, this option is not available when persistent queue is configured using the storage configuration.

config.description: Defines configuration for queueing and batching incoming requests.
